use_cases: Showcase trusted brand logos in a dynamic spinning arrangement for social proof on landing pages
Display partner or integration logos in an engaging animated circular format
Add visual interest to about-us or team pages with brand icon animations
Create a hero section eye-catcher with rotating logo symbols
Demonstrate tool or platform integrations in an animated showcase
ai_summary: A spinning circular logo carousel component that displays brand icons (represented by Lucide React icons) arranged in a ring formation with continuous slow rotation animation. The logos feature solid background colors and sit on a muted container with a subtle border and shadow. Commonly used for social proof, integration showcases, or as an engaging visual element on landing pages.
